frame.kind: local east/north metres about register_point, WGS84 radii (edges, bends, walls and roads are in this frame)

model: MODEL, illustrative scenarios on this test ground. Not a design, not a survey, and no judgement of any real site. Stations, rows, gaps and tracks are ESTIMATED from Esri World Imagery (z17, 0.75 m/px; imagery dated 2025-03-29, +/-0.75 m to the image, +/-8.5 m to the ground); inverter positions, bus split, holes, sections and piles are ASSUMED.
reference: author's reference design: 28 three-phase inverters per 10 MVA station (2 x 5 MVA, two bus bars of 14): 28 ducts and 84 phase cables per station. The planning counts (56 units in 22 hubs, about 36 inverters per unit) are a labelled comparison only and are not drawn.

A.label: A: 3 x 1C 400 mm2 Al XLPE/PVC unarmoured, one duct per inverter, bund side holes
A.scenario: Scenario A: bunded station, side-entry ducts (illustrative)

od_mm.status: assumed (no catalogue entry): 29.7 datasheet NA2XY 1x400; 31.5 derived from the 23.70 mm conductor + 2.0 mm XLPE + 1.9 mm sheath; 33.5 assumed upper bound

mbr_mm.status: assumed: 15 x OD (single-core datasheet basis; 12-15 x OD range)

duct.rule: smallest duct in the table whose jam ratio stays small or very small (preferred: very small) over the assumed OD range scaled to the edited OD, fill <= 40 %, clearance >= max(10 % of ID, 25.4 mm); trefoil circle 2.1547 x OD must fit
duct.default: 125 x 7.4 SDR17 PE (ID 110.2 mm), minimum bend 2,500 mm (20 x OD, datasheet)
duct.status: derived (duct scout D; Southwire PCM 4th ed. eq. 7-24, 7-26, Fig. 7-13, 7-16, Table 7-8 cited, not copied; fill limit is a US code basis, assumed for a UK site)

width.formula: n ducts x duct OD + (n - 1) x 0.100 m + 2 x 0.100 m
width.status: GlobalGrid2050 design page geometry (gap and margins), applied to one duct per inverter

entry.status: assumed: straight perpendicular entry after the bend, before the wall

holes.status: assumed: pre-drilled, one per duct, evenly spread along each wall; where the straight entry leg from an evenly spread hole would cross the table mask, the holes are spread evenly over the clear stretches of that wall (ports.t gives each hole as a fraction of the wall); count per side = ducts assigned to that side

B.label: B: 1C 400 mm2 Al ATA armoured (HDPE sheath), direct buried, piled station, bottom entry
B.scenario: Scenario B: direct-buried armoured, piled station (illustrative; author's reference specification, GlobalGrid2050 cable catalogue)

od_mm.status: datasheet: GlobalGrid2050 Cable Geometry catalogue, data-solar.js sc_al_ata_ac_400

width.formula: 3n cables in one flat layer: 3n x OD + (3n - 1) x spacing + 2 x 0.100 m; spacing = 1 x OD clear (assumed; timber spacers)

entry.status: assumed: straight approach before the upsweep at the MBR into bottom-entry gland plates

B.road_duct: under a road the 3 armoured cores of one circuit share a duct: 140 SDR17 PE (ID 123.4 mm) passes the same jam/fill rule (derived, duct scout D)

piles.status: assumed screw piles, drawn as geometry only; soil and settlement are out of scope (soil repo)

derating: current rating and grouping derating NOT assessed; the 100 mm gap and the spacing are geometric values, not a rating study
cover: cover is not re-assessed in v2 (see v1 note: NSP/002 Table 1 is a DNO policy used as a reference only, not binding on a private site)

routing.method: shortest-path trees per bund side through the free ground between the table rows seen on the imagery (rows, table-end blobs and bunds are obstacles; the 0.5-1 m seams between rows and blobs are closed; ground under 1.5 m clear is allowed at cost 12 and flagged by width); cost rises near obstacles (x up to 2.5 within 3 m) and on tracks (+2, so routes cross roads rather than follow them); CuPy min-plus relaxation, SciPy Dijkstra witness; merged into trench chains where routes share cells; hole order by arrival along the wall, so ducts do not cross outside the bund
routing.note: routes are computed at the default bend radius; edits recompute widths, duct size, layers and bend flags live, not the routes
routing.row_mask: own GPU row mask (scout L): the completion team footprints were not present at build time

table_mask.rule: closed table mask = rows | table-end blobs | seam cells (3x3 closing of rows|blobs, kept only within 1 m of a blob and outside the imagery breaks); the obstacle for routing and the primary rows-crossed metric; the row raster alone and the full 3x3 closing are reported beside it
table_mask.blob_rule: a blob is a TABLE STRIP (folded into rows) if it touches a row within 1.5 m, covers 20 m2 or more, and its median tone is within 15 of the adjacent rows; otherwise it is kept as a DARK BLOB: shadow, ditch, water or unknown object (not identified). Both are obstacles.

unmasked_tables.rule: fix round 2: cells that are dark and blue-leaning (mean of RGB < 70 and blue >= green - 2, 3x3 smoothed) or dark and not green (2.2 m or more from any pale pixel, greenness G - (R + B) / 2 <= 9), inside the farm on router-allowed ground, off the carved E-W breaks, at least 2.5 m wide, are folded into the table mask; every such area of 100 m2 or more was looked at on the imagery and folded only if it is a table. Remaining unmasked dark ground costs 5 times as much to route through.
unmasked_tables.looked_other: buildings, plant, shadows and dark ground circles beside the farm (not tables; not folded)
unmasked_tables.runs: chain runs of 2 m or more on unmasked panel-coloured ground, and chain runs over 1 m on unmasked dark non-green ground, off the carved breaks: listed per station (panel_runs, dark_runs: E, N, m) and drawn in the fault colour

routing.starts: inverter starts snapped to free ground at least 1.5 m clear: first along the row axis (N-S) out of the table block, else the nearest such cell within 20 m. Inverter positions are ASSUMED.
routing.imagery_test: chain runs over 1 m on the full 3x3-closed table mask and at least 1.5 m from any pale pixel of the imagery (pale: above the 1,400 px tile Otsu split, or 6 above the 9x9 local median); listed per station and drawn in the fault colour

section.status: assumed cross-section: running surface over granular sub-base; widths estimated from imagery
